title: Person: Simon Moonan

Simon Moonan

anchor.prefix:
ooking. The fellow turned to Simon Moonan and said:

 —We all know why you speak. You are McGlade’s suck.

 Suck was a queer word. The fellow called Simon Moonan that name because
anchor.suffix: used to tie the prefect’s false sleeves behind his back and the prefect used to let on to be angry. But the sound was ugly. Once he had washed his hands in the lavatory of the Wic
